Team,

Quick preflight for the Q2 expansion forecast: finance needs a validated list of accounts you want included in the March commit window. We're focusing on upsell/upgrade opportunities > $50k ARR that are currently in Negotiation or Demo stage. Please do the following by EOD today: 

- Confirm stage for each open account in the attached pipeline snapshot (pipeline_snapshot_mar25_2027.csv).
- Flag any risks (procurement, legal, SOW changes) and estimate probability adjustments.
- If CS needs to open a success plan or provide final references, note the owner.

I attached a CSV with the current pipeline export. Karthik/Jordan — please double-check any stage changes you already made in CRM so finance isn't reconciling two views. Monica/Avery — CS/AE alignment matters here; if you think a deal should be held out of the commit because of an outstanding compliance question, call it out.

I will roll these up and send a commit readout to Finance by 11:30 PT. Thanks — this is time-boxed.

Best,
Priyom

Priyom — thanks for the heads up. Quick notes from CS after a rapid sweep of the list: 

- Medix Health (Sam Torres / Priya Raman): move from Negotiation -> Commit. CS has confirmed exec approval pending final SOW signature; procurement requested a minor change (term language) yesterday. Risk: low, procurement loop expected to finish next week.
- NovaPath: keep in Negotiation; customer requested an additional performance benchmark; probability down to 45%.
- LumenCare: move to Proposal; CS escalated to success manager for reference calls.

Avery, I left inline comments in the CRM on Medix (comment by me, linked to the opportunity). I can jump on a 15-min call with Sam and Priya to push SOW signature if you want — I have time 3:30–4:00 PT today.

When you roll up, Priyom, please mark Medix as "pending signature" rather than fully closed. We consider SOW signature the final gating event for staging a deal as committed.

—Monica
